name: Felsőcsatár (Hungary)
description: Two equal horizontal stripes of yellow over red, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Felsőcsatár (a red shield with a bishop, a bunch of grapes and ears of grain) above the name FELSŐCSATÁR in black.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
